data.name: mcp-logic
data.does: First-order logic prover and model finder (Prover9/Mace4): prove a conclusion from premises, find counterexamples, check satisfiability and consistency, abductive explanation.
data.good_for: Checking whether a conclusion strictly follows from stated premises; necessary vs sufficient conditions; finding a counterexample to a general rule.
data.not_for: Empirical questions about the world; arithmetic word problems; anything without explicit premises.

data.name: efh-core
data.does: Claim ledger with a verification gate: assert and commit claims, verify implications with Z3 plus a fidelity judge, consistency monitoring across agents, audit trail.
data.good_for: Turning claims into recorded knowledge only after formal verification; keeping many agents' claims consistent over time.
data.not_for: One-off questions; informal notes.

data.name: graph-of-thought
data.does: Runs a graph of LLM operations on its own model: generate many candidate solutions, score them, keep the best, merge and improve.
data.good_for: Exploring many alternative designs, drafts or solutions and pruning to the best; merging several drafts.
data.not_for: Single factual answers; counting or exact computation; long graphs from Cowork (60 s limit).

data.name: jev
data.does: Fast, cheap typed-judgment model: yes/no probabilities, label choice, graded scores over JSON; saved capabilities with composite scores and routing (claim_router, evidence_stance, source_relevance).
data.good_for: Classifying, filtering or ranking many items at once; routing; checking whether wording is supported by stated evidence; relevance of search results.
data.not_for: Counting, arithmetic, dates; generating text; adversarial or untrusted input as a safety gate.

data.name: wisdom-engine
data.does: Generates competing hypotheses for an observation from mechanism, narrative and constraint perspectives, eliminates them by constraints, ad hoc defences and explaining-away, then synthesizes the surviving explanation.
data.good_for: Diagnosing why something happened; listing rival explanations for a symptom or bug; stress-testing a favoured explanation.
data.not_for: Tasks with a known answer or a fixed procedure.

data.name: advanced-reasoning
data.does: Structured reasoning journal: thoughts with hypotheses, evidence, confidence and revisions, stored in a memory graph that persists across sessions.
data.good_for: Long investigations spanning sessions that need a persistent, revisable reasoning trail.
data.not_for: Short tasks; tasks whose answer does not depend on a reasoning record.

data.name: context-compressor
data.does: Compresses long text or files into summaries that keep named entities and key facts; stores searchable chunks that can be expanded later.
data.good_for: Fitting long documents, logs or conversation history into limited context; searching compressed notes.
data.not_for: Exact quotation; short texts.

data.name: PageIndex
data.does: Document library for long PDFs and reports: upload, structure-aware browsing, relevance search, and page-level retrieval.
data.good_for: Answering questions about long PDFs, specs, papers or reports; finding which pages discuss a topic.
data.not_for: Code; short documents already in context.

data.name: pdf-viewer
data.does: Displays a PDF to the user in the app and navigates or interacts with its pages.
data.good_for: Showing Ty a PDF or a specific page while discussing it.
data.not_for: Extracting or searching content in bulk.

data.name: ast-asg
data.does: Parses code into syntax trees and semantic graphs, analyzes whole projects, syncs code structure to Neo4j, structural search and pattern-based transforms.
data.good_for: Understanding the structure of an unfamiliar codebase; finding or refactoring all uses of a function or pattern structurally.
data.not_for: Prose; single small edits.

data.name: project-synapse
data.does: Knowledge graph and wiki: ingest text, formal semantic parsing, explore connections between entities, remember and recall memories over time, maintain wiki pages.
data.good_for: Building or querying a personal knowledge base; finding non-obvious connections between concepts in notes.
data.not_for: One-off lookups; code.

data.name: aseke-compass
data.does: Scaffolds analysis of human behavior, situations or conflicts using affective neuroscience (primary emotional systems) and behavioural patterns.
data.good_for: Understanding motivations behind a person's or group's behaviour or a conflict.
data.not_for: Technical or factual tasks.

data.name: advanced-writer
data.does: Fiction and narrative toolkit: brainstorm ideas, develop characters, build a world bible, choose a story structure, draft, expand and revise stories.
data.good_for: Writing or revising stories, novels and other narrative fiction.
data.not_for: Technical documentation; factual reports.

data.name: LocalREPL
data.does: Persistent Python REPLs and shells running on Ty's real computer (not the sandbox VM), keeping state across calls, with a searchable command log.
data.good_for: Work that needs Ty's actual machine: the GPU, local services such as Ollama or Neo4j, long-running processes, state kept across many steps.
data.not_for: Tasks the sandbox shell already handles, such as editing files in a connected folder.

data.name: Desktop Commander
data.does: Shell, process control, file search and editing on Ty's computer; long-running processes, SSH, reading structured files.
data.good_for: Managing processes and services on Ty's machine, SSH, searching the filesystem beyond connected folders.
data.not_for: Tasks the sandbox shell already handles in connected folders.

data.name: Context7
data.does: Looks up current documentation and code examples for libraries and frameworks.
data.good_for: Writing code against a library API; checking current versions, options and usage.
data.not_for: Non-code questions.

data.name: Shadcn UI
data.does: Source code, demos, blocks and themes for shadcn/ui React components.
data.good_for: Building React user interfaces with standard components and themes.
data.not_for: Backend code; non-React interfaces.

data.name: GitHub
data.does: GitHub repositories, files, branches, issues, pull requests and releases for Ty's account (angrysky56).
data.good_for: Opening or reviewing pull requests, filing issues, reading remote repos, releases.
data.not_for: Local-only work that is not on GitHub.

data.name: Hugging Face
data.does: Search Hugging Face models, datasets, papers and Spaces; inspect repos; run jobs and sandboxes on Hugging Face.
data.good_for: Finding a model or dataset for a job; reading model cards; running compute on Hugging Face.
data.not_for: Local GPU work on Ty's machine.

data.name: Built-in browser
data.does: Claude's browser pane: open web pages, read them, fill forms, take screenshots.
data.good_for: Interacting with websites that need clicking, forms, or logins; reading pages that the fetch tool cannot.
data.not_for: Plain web search or reading simple pages.
